head.title1: Ombra: free full-body tracking and VRChat app for SteamVR
page.h11: Everything for VR, in one shadow.
page.p2: Latest version, free. Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, no admin rights.
features.li9: Walk calibration: a few steps line up your hips, legs and feet
features.li18: Ankles that bend, from the HaritoraX 2 distance sensor
features.li34: Who is in your instance, which avatar they wear and how heavy it is
features.li36: Hide that avatar in one click, undo any time
features.li39: A warning on your wrist when an avatar drags your frame rate down
features.li42: OSC trackers for VRChat on a Quest, without SteamVR
features.li43: VMC for VSeeFace, Warudo, VNyan and other VTuber apps
features.li50: Warnings in VR when a tracker drops or its battery runs low
features.li53: Full body on and off in one tap, back without recalibrating
privacy.lead: In a world where everything sits behind a paywall,
privacy.h21: Ombra is free. And it doesn't even keep your data.
privacy.p1: Here is everything Ombra does with the internet, and everything it doesn't.
privacy.stay1: Your settings, calibration and body measurements
privacy.stay2: Crash reports, and what Ombra reads from VRChat's log
privacy.stay3: Your heart rate and the music you play
privacy.online1: check GitHub for a new version, if you leave it on
privacy.online2: download tracker firmware from Shiftall, when you update
privacy.online3: reach the services you connect yourself, like Pulsoid
p-home.p1: The body Ombra builds from your sensors and headset, in front, side or free 3D view. Each tracker shows whether it is tracked, simulated or out of signal.
p-home.li1: Battery, rate and signal for every sensor at a glance
p-home.li3: Calibrate, Quick and Reset facing one click away
p-trackers.p1: Serial, firmware, dongle slot, battery voltage, signal on both ends, magnetometer state and the real update rate.
p-trackers.li1: Change body part, update rate (100 or 50 Hz) and sensor mode
p-trackers.li2: Turn the status light off when you film yourself
p-dongles.p1: A GX2 has two slots; a GX6 has three radio modules with two slots each. Ombra shows every module, the tracker in each slot and its channel.
p-dongles.li1: Pair and unpair trackers without VR Manager
p-dongles.li2: Change channels, with a warning when two modules clash
p-dongles.li3: Find newly plugged-in dongles with one click
p-calib.p1: Stand straight, bend into a ski pose, then rise on your tiptoes with foot trackers. Ombra shows which body part to check when something is off.
p-calib.li3: Measure your body and the floor by touching them with a controller
p-smooth.p1: Smooth, Balanced, Responsive or Off, or any level on a slider. Give a single tracker its own style, for example calmer feet.
p-smooth.li2: Can smooth other IMU trackers in SteamVR too, if you choose
p-drift.p1: Drift correction runs while you play, and a live table shows what it is doing on each body part.
p-drift.li1: Fewer resets, also during long sessions
p-drift.li2: Turn each part of it on or off
p-drift.li3: Gets better the more you play
p-body.p1: Your body stays believable: feet stay above the floor, planted feet don't slide, knees never bend backwards.
p-body.li1: Covers short signal dropouts with a smooth estimated pose
p-body.li3: Choose which trackers SteamVR sees, per game
p-fw.p1: Update trackers over Bluetooth and dongles over USB with Shiftall's original firmware files, unmodified.
p-fw.li1: Test the Bluetooth switch first, without changing anything
p-fw.li2: Warns when trackers run mixed firmware versions
p-fw.li3: Every file is checked (SHA-256) before it is used
install.p1: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and SteamVR. HaritoraX 2, 2 Pro or Wireless with a GX dongle, or SlimeVR-compatible trackers.
install.p2: One file, Ombra-Setup.exe. The button below always gets the latest version.
install.p3: Only one app can use the dongles at a time.
install.p5: Turn on your trackers, start SteamVR, put them on and press Calibrate.
faq.summary1: Do I still need Shiftall VR Manager?
faq.summary3: Why does Windows warn me about the installer?
faq.p4: The installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen doesn't recognise it. Click More info, then Run anyway. The setup installs into your user folder and needs no admin rights.
faq.summary4: How does Ombra show up in SteamVR?
faq.p5: The setup installs Ombra's own SteamVR driver. Your trackers appear in SteamVR with their roles already set (hip, chest, knees, feet, elbows), and SteamVR starts Ombra for you.
faq.summary5: Will it touch my headset, controllers or base stations?
faq.p6: No. Lighthouse devices, headsets and controllers are never modified. The driver only creates Ombra's virtual trackers and, only if you turn it on, smooths other IMU trackers.
faq.summary9: Can I try it without trackers?
faq.p10: Yes. Run Ombra.exe --demo for eight demo trackers on a GX2 and a GX6. The demo never touches COM ports, Bluetooth, SteamVR or your settings.
faq.p11: The app and this site are in English, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Russian. Ombra picks your Windows language and you can change it in Settings.
faq.summary11: Is it affiliated with Shiftall or Valve?
faq.p12: No. Ombra is an independent project, free to download and use. The source code is not published; you can propose features, extensions and translations on GitHub.

dl-toast.p2: When Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen doesn't know it.
dl-toast.p3: If Ombra works well for you, a star on GitHub helps other people find it.

meta.description: Free Windows app for HaritoraX and SlimeVR trackers: full-body tracking in SteamVR, a VRChat chatbox with heart rate, and crasher protection. No account.
meta.og_title: Ombra: everything for VR, in one shadow
meta.og_description: Full-body tracking, a VRChat chatbox, crasher protection and VR panels in one app. Free for Windows, no account, your data stays on your PC.
hero.lede: One free Windows app for your whole VR session: full-body tracking for HaritoraX and SlimeVR-compatible trackers, a VRChat chatbox with your music and heart rate, protection from crashers, and panels on your wrist.
trk.h2: Full-body tracking that moves like your shadow.
trk.p: Ombra runs HaritoraX and SlimeVR-compatible trackers in SteamVR on its own, without VR Manager or SlimeVR Server. It builds your body from the sensors and your headset and keeps every tracker steady, quick and free of drift.
trk.alt_health: Health page: lost packets, signal and real update rate for each tracker, next to SteamVR's dropped frames.
trk.home_elbows: Elbows from your controllers, without arm trackers
trk.calib_start: Start it from VR: both triggers, a T-pose, a tap on a tracker or a keyboard shortcut
trk.calib_quick: Quick calibration remembers how each tracker sits, even after a restart
trk.smooth_predict: Every pose carries its speed, so SteamVR predicts it to the frame
trk.body_sit: Sitting and lying down: Ombra finds the bed, sofa or floor under you by itself
trk.trackers_slime: SlimeVR-compatible trackers over Wi-Fi or a USB receiver, Wi-Fi set up through the cable
trk.health_h: Is it the radio or your PC?
trk.health_p: When tracking stutters, the Health page shows where it comes from: each tracker's lost packets, signal and real update rate, next to the frames SteamVR dropped.
trk.health_li1: The last minutes as a graph, per tracker
trk.health_li2: A plain answer, not just numbers
vrc.h2: Your VRChat chatbox, with your music and your heartbeat.
vrc.p: Build what your chatbox shows line by line, with live values in it. Ombra keeps it tidy and never floods it.
vrc.alt_chat: Chatbox section: the theme's lines in order, each with its preview, and the bubble as VRChat will show it.
vrc.alt_vrc: VRChat page with the full-body settings Ombra recommends for your trackers.
vrc.chat_p: Lines for the song, your heart rate, your status and the time: drag them into order, add pieces with a click, and see each line as VRChat will show it. Decorators and text styles use only characters VRChat can draw. Save a layout as a theme and share it as a code. Too long for the bubble? It turns the page instead of cutting your text.
vrc.chat_li1: What you play on Spotify or any other player, without logging in, with play, pause and skip on your wrist
vrc.chat_li2: Heart rate from Pulsoid or straight from a Bluetooth strap or watch, also sent to your avatar
vrc.chat_li3: Statuses only Ombra knows: away, asleep, full body on or off
vrc.chat_li4: It sends only when the text changes: no spam, no chatbox timeouts
vrc.vrc_p: Ombra's calibration also calibrates VRChat, and the full-body settings VRChat recommends for your trackers are one click away, with undo.
safe.h2: Crashed? Ombra tells you who did it.
safe.p: VRChat notes who joins and which avatar they load. Ombra reads that log on your PC, so after a crash you see the likely crasher, and their avatar is one click away from hidden.
safe.alt: Safety page: a crash report with the likely crasher, the avatar they loaded and how many seconds before the crash.
safe.li_report: After a crash: the likely crasher, their avatar and how many seconds before
safe.li_auto: Optional: hide it by itself after two crashes from the same person, and rejoin with a countdown you can cancel
safe.li_never: It never asks for your VRChat password and never touches the game
invr.p: What you need while you play is on your wrist and in the SteamVR dashboard.
invr.alt_wrist: The wrist panel: time, trackers, the song playing, heart rate and buttons for calibrate and reset facing.
invr.alt_dash: Ombra's tab in the SteamVR dashboard with every tracker, its battery and big calibrate buttons.
invr.wrist_p: Look at your wrist and it fades in: the time, your trackers, what's playing, your heart rate and your PC's notifications. Look away and it's gone.
invr.wrist_li1: Calibrate, Quick and Reset facing with a touch of the other hand
invr.wrist_li3: Sleep mode: a calm body and a quiet voice while you sleep
invr.dash_h: A tab in the SteamVR dashboard
invr.dash_p: Every tracker with its battery, big buttons for calibrate and reset facing, and the switches you change while you play.
invr.dash_li2: Space drag: hold a button and pull the world, with fling and gravity
more.native_p: No browser inside, and 12 colour themes. SteamVR starts Ombra, and it waits in the tray with a panel for your trackers.
more.bar_p: The buttons you use most, in the order you want.
more.update_p: Ombra tells you when a new version is out and never updates while SteamVR runs.
more.resume_p: Optional: after a restart, Ombra calibrates by itself once you stand still.
install.p4b: It needs no admin rights and registers the SteamVR driver. Windows warns you? See the questions below.
faq.vrm: No. Ombra reads the dongles itself, pairs trackers and updates firmware with Shiftall's original files. Keep VR Manager closed while Ombra runs.
faq.trackers: HaritoraX 2, 2 Pro and Wireless through GX2 or GX6 dongles, and SlimeVR-compatible trackers over Wi-Fi or a USB receiver, for example Butterfly and Smol Slime. Base-station trackers such as Vive trackers can be lined up with a Quest, and Ombra can also smooth other IMU trackers already in SteamVR. HaritoraX 1 (wired) is not supported.
faq.quest_q: Does it work with a Quest?
faq.quest_a: Yes. With a PC, through SteamVR: Link, Air Link, Virtual Desktop or Steam Link. With VRChat running on the Quest itself, Ombra sends your body over OSC from your PC, without SteamVR.
foot.tag: Independent and free, made in Italy.
